// State machine with one register (s) and one combinational next-state
// function.
module TopModule(input clk, input reset, input w, output reg z);
  reg [2:0] s, sn;
  always @(*) begin
    case (s)
      3'b000: begin z = 1'b0; sn = w ? 3'b010 : 3'b000; end
      3'b001: begin z = 1'b0; sn = w ? 3'b010 : 3'b001; end
      3'b010: begin z = 1'b0; sn = w ? 3'b011 : 3'b000; end
      3'b011: begin z = 1'b0; sn = w ? 3'b011 : 3'b001; end
      3'b100: begin z = 1'b1; sn = w ? 3'b100 : 3'b000; end
      3'b101: begin z = 1'b1; sn = w ? 3'b100 : 3'b001; end
      3'b110: begin z = 1'b1; sn = w ? 3'b000 : 3'b000; end
      3'b111: begin z = 1'b1; sn = w ? 3'b000 : 3'b001; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) s <= 3'b000;
    else s <= sn;
  end
endmodule

samples.raw_completion:
// One-hot state encoding: state is fully specified by the register s itself,
// together with the combinational next-state function.
module TopModule(input  clk, input reset, input w, output reg z);
  reg [2:0] s, s_next;
  always @* begin
    case (s)
      3'b000: begin z = 1'b0; s_next = (w ? 3'b010 : 3'b001); end
      3'b001: begin z = 1'b0; s_next = (w ? 3'b011 : 3'b000); end
      3'b010: begin z = 1'b1; s_next = (w ? 3'b100 : 3'b000); end
      3'b011: begin z = 1'b1; s_next = (w ? 3'b101 : 3'b001); end
      3'b100: begin z = 1'b0; s_next = (w ? 3'b110 : 3'b001); end
      3'b101: begin z = 1'b0; s_next = (w ? 3'b111 : 3'b000); end
      3'b110: begin z = 1'b0; s_next = (w ? 3'b000 : 3'b010); end
      3'b111: begin z = 1'b0; s_next = (w ? 3'b001 : 3'b011); end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) s <= 3'b000;
    else       s <= s_next;
  end
endmodule
